e405_acceptance_audit.meaning_of_as_run_flag: completed procedure only; did not gate nonzero worker_errors
validation_failures: 1000/ACTIVE: active endpoint count differs at final observation

conditions.baseline_geometry_operator_context: Original actual footprint was 3 x 2 loaded chunks, verified by root separately; original raw benchmark did not save x/geometry. No origin inferred from second-resolution report utc.
conditions.backend: Isolated loopback dev_perf_v1; raw MySQL/Redis/Minecraft/NeoForge conditions retained in source reports.
conditions.JFR: Both performance drivers recorded their existing profile JFR; this offline derivation starts no tools.

limitations: Baseline DB first snapshot is absent, so full-120s DB/Sql-helper/WAL deltas are UNMEASURED; never subtract neighboring phase-final cumulative snapshots.
Baseline late monitor covers only the last ~46s of 500 ACTIVE and ~118s post-reset 1000 OFF/ACTIVE. Earlier 100 and 500 OFF counters/CPU/heap are UNMEASURED.

e405 accepted business inputs differ from original; no fixed-input success/efficiency claim from failed 500/1000 stages. Warmup buffers and sequential bulk/status captures mean output can exceed window input; this scale fixture does not independently audit final resource conservation.
Nominal OFF does not establish clean idle; e405 500/1000 OFF still completed worker tasks and had ready devices.

Mod tick/delivery/sql percentile fields are bounded ring snapshots; not whole-Minecraft or guaranteed full-120s distributions. Native recorded-tick average100 exists only in e405, has unknown recording age, and target20 is not measured actual TPS.

Original performance metrics regex truncates exponent notation. Only affected microsecond-scale fields are excluded; integer DB/errors/FE counters and ordinary decimal fields here are unchanged. Raw monitor retains exponent replies; monitor numeric parser skips exponent fields rather than truncating.
e405 initial monitor failure remains a failed source, not hidden by successful ready-monitor replacement.
